verdict.rationale: The pack documents only SDK-level model download primitives (progress events and DownloadProgress fields). Those are developer building blocks, not a user-facing hub for managing downloaded models. Nothing in the evidence covers saved prompts or per-model configuration, and the console playground keeping recent conversations is an adjacent feature, not prompt management.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place
